title: [announce_routes] announce_routes.yml is broken for ptf32/ptf64 topology
author: shlomibitton
body:

**Description**
After recent change on PR https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/2741 when trying to deploy with ptf32 topology the step fail.
It is not expected to run 'announce_routes' on ptf32 topology, previously it was a seperate test now it is integrated into the deploy script, thus need to exclude this kind of topologies.

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Deploy a ptf32 topology on a switch.
2. Observe the deploy failure.

**Describe the results you received:**
TASK [vm_set : Start exabgp processes for IPv4 on PTF] ************************* 

fatal: [SONIC]: FAILED! => {"msg": "The task includes an option with an undefined variable. The error was: 'None' has no attribute 'key'\n\nThe error appears to be in '/root/mars/workspace/sonic-mgmt/ansible/roles/vm_set/tasks/announce_routes.yml': line 26, column 3, but may\nbe elsewhere in the file depending on the exact syntax problem.\n\nThe offending line appears to be:\n\n\n- name: Start exabgp processes for IPv4 on PTF\n  ^ here\n"} 

**Describe the results you expected:**
The step should pass successfully.
